# Davis combined-article capture

Captured from https://ecode360.com/44632455 on 2026-10-30 using the real shared
browser/content scraper. The provider rendered 37 sections across two articles;
the recorded Davis TOC owns 14 for article 44632455. `article-before.json` retains
the full raw HTML and original over-extraction, while `toc-44632455.json` records
exact article membership. Tests prove both corrected selection and continued
rejection of missing members or altered parsed text.
